column2: These low rogues are loitering on station in the lower decks and stripping the alpha shielding. The chief wants them gone.
Miners on Gallows Rock dug too deep and came back wrong. The claim owners want their rock back.
Bob is a troubadour with a penchant for heists. His band are counting bits on Verdan.
Smugglers and poachers have dug in across the caverns of Zuzax. The planetary board wants the whole crew gone.
